product.title: Penedes Wine & Cava Tasting & 4WD Vineyards Tour from Barcelona

description.text: Become more acquainted with Spain’s Penedès region on this cava-and-wine-tasting tour that sets off from Barcelona. Visit a winery in Sant Sadurní d'Anoia, the capital of cava, Catalonia’s answer to champagne, then explore a second winery’s vineyards on a Jeep. Stops include Sant Sadurní d'Anoia, Penedès vineyards. Needless to say, you’ll get the opportunity to taste both wine and cava, and indulge in local delights such as cheese and charcuterie. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
